claim_text: The selected official IceCube HESE sample contains a north/south residual inconsistent with the official public-MC response.

provenance.evidence: All four official IceCube Git blob identities match the pinned manifest.

preregistration.evidence: Frozen energy/event cut and hemisphere diagnostic.

ordinary_baseline.evidence: Official MC response replaces the rejected 50/50 baseline.

synthetic_calibration.evidence: Repository calibration and null machinery passed focused tests.

response_model.evidence: Official public MC weights used; PHOTOSPLINE detector corrections unavailable.

systematics.evidence: Thirteen nominal/one-at-a-time flux-background scenarios tested; detector splines remain a limitation.

multiple_testing.evidence: One primary mixture diagnostic; exploratory component family Holm-adjusted.

ordinary_alternatives.evidence: Detector acceptance explains the legacy apparent imbalance.

independent_dataset.evidence: Separate Pierre Auger directional track executed, addressing a different instrument and statistic.

independent_replication.evidence: No independent team reproduction of this exact computation.

limitations: Intermediate official-MC response, not the full IceCube likelihood or detector-spline model.
